subject.title: feature request: `chat.history` should support a visible-only filter so `limit` can count conversation messages instead of transcript rows

question: Should `chat.history` gain a first-class conversation-view pagination mode, and should that mode preserve supported non-text display blocks or return text/thinking-only content?
rationale: This changes a public gateway contract and requires durable cursor, total-count, mixed-content, and compatibility semantics that implementation evidence cannot decide safely.

options.title: Add a named conversation view
options.body: Add an opt-in view with visible-message pagination and explicit visible totals while preserving the current default and supported display blocks.

options.title: Add the proposed boolean
options.body: Add `visibleOnly` with text/thinking-only filtering, accepting a narrower contract that may require another mode for richer clients later.

options.title: Keep raw pagination only
options.body: Require clients to paginate transcript rows, preserving API simplicity but retaining excessive transfer and shallow visible pages.

recommendation.title: Add a named conversation view
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in view with visible-message pagination and explicit visible totals while preserving the current default and supported display blocks.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal for chat display projection and visibility semantics points to this contributor.
